verdict: Easy for your own workspace, a real gate if you want public distribution.
time: Own workspace: under 1 hour (estimate, not from docs). Distribute to any workspace: about 1 to 2 days of work (estimate). Marketplace review time: not checked.

blockers.text: Distribution needs a public HTTPS redirect URL and no hardcoded secrets.

Apps distributed commercially but not approved for the Slack Marketplace are limited to 1 request per minute on conversations.history and conversations.replies, with a max of 15 objects per call. Applies to apps created after 2025-05-29 and to new installs of existing apps; internal customer-built apps are not affected.
Marketplace review needs privacy policy, support contact and a working demo.

steps: Create an app at api.slack.com/apps (from scratch).
Under OAuth & Permissions add redirect URL and the minimum bot and user scopes.
Install to your dev workspace and test the token exchange (oauth.v2.access).
Under Manage Distribution, complete the checklist and activate public distribution.
If you need discoverability or higher limits, submit to the Slack Marketplace.
agent: Draft the scope list from the actions your agent needs
Generate the redirect and token-exchange code
Run an install against a test workspace you own and check the returned scopes
you: Create the app in your Slack account
Own the domain, HTTPS endpoint and privacy policy
Submit the Marketplace form and answer reviewer questions
